market_context: US markets opened lower on Nov 24, 2026, as the massive AI-driven rally from Monday faded. Tech and chip stocks lead declines, with Nvidia down over 5% and AMD over 8%, while the Dow edged higher due to rotation into defensive and value sectors. Breadth was positive, but elevated VIX and a 1.8% Nasdaq drop signal lingering tech weakness.

predictions.reasoning: The S&P 500 was off 0.35% at 10:00 AM ET, with tech weighing heavily. The 'Huang rally' reversal [finance.yahoo.com] and ongoing chip sell-off [stocktitan.net] suggest further mild downside into the close, though losses may be cushioned by strong breadth and healthcare gains.

Nasdaq 100 was down 1.36% intraday, with Nvidia, AMD, and other chip names plunging after Monday's surge [barrons.com]. Pre-market data showed QQQ giving back about a third of the prior day's gain [stocktitan.net], and the tech rout is likely to persist through the session.

The Dow Jones was the only major index in positive territory at 10:00 ET, up 0.42%, as investors rotated out of tech into value and defensive sectors [finance.yahoo.com]. Strong breadth and positive contributions from healthcare and other non-tech groups support a slightly higher close.

Nvidia shares were down 5.41% by 10:00 AM, giving back a portion of the prior day's 31% spike [finance.yahoo.com]. Pre-market indications showed the stock shedding roughly a fifth of Monday's gain [stocktitan.net], and profit-taking is likely to persist as the AI rally cools.

Small caps outperformed on Tuesday, with IWM up 0.43% amid a rotation away from large-cap tech [metacap.si]. Positive breadth and reduced correlation with mega-cap tech suggest the Russell 2000 can hold or extend its gains into the close.
